slides.title: Your ground coffee goes stale fast
slides.subtitle: Four habits keep it tasting fresh for longer.

slides.title: Air is the main enemy
slides.body: Ground coffee has far more surface than whole beans, so oxygen reaches it faster. Heat and moisture speed up staling too.
slides.highlight: Less air, less heat, less moisture.

slides.title: Storing it, in order
steps: Pour it into an airtight container.
Pick a size that leaves little empty space.
Keep it in a cool, dark cupboard.
Keep it away from the stove and sink.

slides.label: The tip
slides.body: Close the lid right after you scoop. An open container lets in air and kitchen steam.

slides.title: Closed, cool, dark and dry
slides.body: Less air, heat and moisture keeps ground coffee fresher.
